column1: # The function words the converter treats specially, and what it does with each.
# These were constants in pravapis/rules/morphology.py and pravapis/lexicon/case_forms.py.
# They are inventories, not patterns: closed lists of particular words that decide what
# the converter outputs. A port that guesses them is wrong in ways no rule file shows,
# so they are published here, under the data version, like every other table.
# particle_n2t                 N -> T: this proclitic takes jakanne before a stressed
#                              first syllable (не -> ня). `target` is the soft form.
# particle_t2n                 T -> N: the soft form and what it reverts to.
# softening_preposition        Збор 2005 §29: assimilative softness extends to these
#                              prepositions (зь вераю, бязь сьлёз). `target` is unused.
# clitic                       Unstressed in connected speech, so it never counts as a
# stressed_initial_u           §18 exception: the initial У carries the stress, so the
#                              rule does not reach it. Stems, so inflections are covered.
# dative_locative_preposition  Picks the dative/locative column of
# `target` is `-` where the role needs no target. `citation` names the § a role rests on.
